evidence.title: GitHub - openstatusHQ/time-picker: A simple shadcn/ui TimePicker component · GitHub

name: TimePicker
summary: Copy-paste shadcn/ui time picker built on plain inputs, with keydown handling and arrow-key navigation and no extra dependencies.
description: A TimePickerInput component for React and shadcn/ui made of hours, minutes, seconds and period fields. It listens to keydown events, supports arrow-key navigation, formats date values and optimises the mobile keyboard; install by copying two files, with the Select component needed for twelve-hour clocks.
contains: hour, minute, second and period fields
no additional library; formats date values
mobile keyboard optimised; twelve-hour clocks also use the Select component
